summary.text: Catherine "Barcy" Whitson, an independent, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. Senate in Tennessee to Bill Hagerty.
According to her campaign website, she had a career in the insurance industry and has spent about 20 years as a volunteer life coach, pastor and mentor.

paragraphs.text: Whitson goes by Barcy and said she was running for the 2027-2033 term to promote "What Tennesseans Want."
She was on the November 3, 2026 ballot as an independent.
She received 0.2% of the vote to Bill Hagerty's 55.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
